title: Principal opens cover Spec R iff unit ideal; Spec R is quasi-compact
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $\operatorname{Spec}R$ its set of prime ideals with the Zariski topology, and for $r\in R$ let $D(r)=\{\mathfrak q\in\operatorname{Spec}R: r\notin\mathfrak q\}$. Then: (i) for any family $(r_i)_{i\in I}$ of elements of $R$, $\bigcup_{i\in I}D(r_i)=\operatorname{Spec}R$ if and only if the $r_i$ generate the unit ideal of $R$; (ii) in particular, for $r\in R$, $D(r)=\operatorname{Spec}R$ (i.e. $r$ lies in no prime ideal) if and only if $r$ is a unit of $R$; (iii) the topological space $\operatorname{Spec}R$ is quasi-compact.

source.place: Algebra, Lemma 00E0 (label lemma-Zariski-topology), items (8) ($V(I)=\emptyset$ iff $I=R$), (13), (16) ($D(f)=\operatorname{Spec}R$ implies $f$ a unit); Lemma 00E8 (label lemma-quasi-compact)
